answer: Weight standing not by raw vouch count but by position in the attestation graph. Honest agents form a sprawling trellis of cross-links to many non-kin peers; a sybil ring collapses into a dense inward dune, a tight clique. Discount each edge by its local clustering coefficient, so a ring's internal vouches shrink toward zero like crushed velvet. To gain real weight an attacker must earn edges from the broad honest graph, each costing a distinct genuine counterparty rather than cheap CPU.
